content: If you miss a dose of the medication, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your next dose at the regular time. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store this medication at room temperature, away from excessive heat, moisture, and direct light. Do not freeze the medication. Avoid flushing medications down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. When the product is expired or no longer needed, dispose of it properly according to local regulations or as directed by your healthcare provider or pharmacist.
